query: Original report exactly as used by old C (saved S0 embedding query without instruction; existing 512-token query budget)
evidence: Per candidate: A best chunk, then B highest distinct chunks up to3; identical to old C
scoring: Fresh Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B on the union of both pools' selected chunks; each identical query-document pair scored once and shared by both arms. No reuse of historical model scores.
batch_order: Old C chunk order followed by newly introduced chunks in new AB order; batch16, BF16, max1536 tokens
aggregation: Max chunk score per file; tie by each arm's own AB rank
failure_policy: Retain all500; existing B failure counts zero in all dependent routes; infrastructure or integrity errors stop and resume from immutable checkpoints
statistics: 5000 project-stratified paired bootstrap and paired randomization repetitions; Holm over two contrasts times MAP/MRR/Top1/Top10/Recall10
scope: Same observed development500, not blind evaluation. No retuning AB or C. Current initial baseline remains frozen.
